verse.verse_1: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
verse.verse_3: And push home the charge in the morning,
verse.verse_4: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
verse.verse_5: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
verse.verse_6: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
verse.verse_7: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
verse.verse_8: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
verse.verse_9: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
verse.verse_10: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
verse.verse_11: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
